title: Understanding AIF Categories: Category I, II, and III Explained
description: A deep-dive comparison of Category I, II and III Alternative Investment Funds for investors who already know what an AIF is and want to go further. Go past the basic definitions into the investment conditions, leverage limits and structural nuances that actually separate a venture capital fund from a hedge fund from a real estate AIF, compare how each category is taxed under the pass-through and fund-level regimes, and build a practical framework for choosing between categories as an HNI, angel investor or experienced retail investor moving into alternatives.
